verdict.rationale: Instinct documents a workspace tool for deleting all data indexed from external sources, a way to revoke Google access, and a training opt-out (Vault materials are excluded from training). Peter Yang confirms the deletion tool was added after the agent refused to delete his Gmail records. However, disconnecting an account does not delete data already indexed: Claire Vo's emails stayed stored in plain text after she disconnected, and the original ToS granted a perpetual, irrevocable license to user materials. Missing for 10: retention-period controls, documented deletion of conversation and agent memory data, deletion on disconnect by default, and independent verification that the delete tool fully purges data.
